sentences.en: Juha came back from the market at night.
He walked and walked and came back to the same place.

sentences.ar: قعد تحت شجرة وقال: بستنى الصبح.
sentences.en: He sat under a tree and said: I will wait for the morning.

sentences.ar: نام شوي وصحي على صوت ديك.
sentences.en: He slept a little and woke to the sound of a rooster.
He found himself in front of his own door.

sentences.ar: قال: أقرب طريق للبيت هو النوم.
sentences.en: He said: the shortest way home is sleep.
